title: Genie Code analysis for alerts is in Beta
body: If the **Alertv2 Genie Analysis** preview is enabled, alert owners can turn on Genie Code analysis in **Advanced settings**. When an alert changes to **Triggered** or **Error**, Genie Code starts an investigation and adds an **Investigate** link to the alert history. See [Configure Genie Code analysis](/aws/en/sql/user/alerts/create#configure-genie-code-analysis).
